beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Casinos make money even on the nights you win. Here's how.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Follow one $10 bet. Three clues on this table explain it, and the last is why they love your lucky nights.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Clue one is green. When the ball lands on a green zero, every red and black bet loses. That's the house edge: 5.26% of every bet, on average.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Clue two is time. Nobody plays just one spin. Bet $10 a spin for an hour, and that edge adds up to about $20 for the house.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Only $20 an hour? That's nothing. I'll have another drink.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Clue three is the crowd. The casino takes that slice at every table, every night. Over a year of Saturdays, your slice alone comes to $5,197.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: And your lucky nights? I love them. A win is the free drink that brings you back next Saturday.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: That's how the casino wins without luck: a small edge on every bet, and players who keep coming back. Ten years of Rohan's Saturdays come to $51,969.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Fine. But one more spin couldn't hurt, right?
